summary: Add shared parseCitationsBlock() util + unit tests
description:
Add src/lib/citations.ts exporting parseCitationsBlock(raw: string): { body: string; citations: ParsedCitation[] }.

PARSE the block emitted per src/lib/prompt.ts CORE_RULES:
  CITATIONS:
  [TRADITION | TEXT | SECTION | TIER: verified/proposed/inferred]
  "optional short quote"
  [ ... more entries ... ]

- Match from a line-start 'CITATIONS:' marker to end of string (mirror blog-generate.ts:286 regex: /\n*CITATIONS:[\s\S]*$/m).
- Each bracketed line -> { tradition, text, section, tier, quote? }. Split on '|', trim. Strip the leading 'TIER:' label from the 4th field; lowercase + validate tier against verified|proposed|inferred, default 'inferred' on miss.
- A quoted line immediately following a bracket line attaches as that entry's optional quote (strip surrounding curly/straight quotes).
- tradition kept as emitted (Citation lowercases for the color lookup itself).
- body = input with the CITATIONS block stripped, trimmed.

REUSE: refactor blog-generate.ts parseGenerated to call this for the strip (keep its TITLE/DEK head parsing) so there is one CITATIONS regex in the codebase. The ParsedCitation shape should line up with citation.tsx CitationProps (tradition,text,section,quote?,tier) so it feeds the component directly.

TESTS (src/__tests__/citations.test.ts): well-formed single + multiple entries; no block present (citations:[] , body unchanged); malformed/short lines skipped gracefully; optional quote attached; TIER label + casing normalized; unknown tier -> inferred. Mirror fixtures in existing prompt.test.ts / blog-generate.test.ts.

DONE: util + passing unit tests committed; blog-generate strip delegated to it with its existing tests still green.
